description: This file defines the AllCompatibleVersionsSelector class which implements the IVersionSelector interface. It provides a method to select compatible versions from a list of available versions based on a requested version and a compatibility check.

classes.name: AllCompatibleVersionsSelector
classes.description: A class that selects all available versions compatible with the requested version using a compatibility director.

methods.name: GetSuitableVersion
methods.description: Returns an array of available versions that are compatible with the requested version based on the provided compatibility director.
